events.description: 3D Axes and Camera Setup with Equation Overlay
events.clip_query: A 3D coordinate system rotates slowly while the Lorenz system differential equations appear in the top-left corner.

events.description: Initialization of Trajectories and Glow Dots
events.clip_query: Multiple glowing dots appear at the starting point of the trajectories and begin to move, leaving faint trails.
The glowing dots trace out the classic butterfly shape of the Lorenz attractor, gradually diverging from each other due to chaos.
